body.name: Forward CGD Doob decomposition
body.construction: At reveal rank \(s\), let \(J_{n,s}=\sum_{i:(\mathsf P_n)_{\rho_n(s),i}=1}\delta_{n,i}h_{n,i,<s}\), \(C_{n,s}=\delta_{n,\rho_n(s)}h_{n,\rho_n(s)}/p_n-J_{n,s}/t_n\), and \(G_{n,s}=\gamma_{n,\rho_n(s)}h_{n,\rho_n(s)}/p_n\). The coordinate identity to audit is \[M_{n,s}=C_{n,s}(R_{n,\rho_n(s)}-p_n)+G_{n,s}R_{n,\rho_n(s)}S_{n,\rho_n(s)},\qquad Q_n=p_n\sum_{s=1}^n\{t_nC_{n,s}^2+G_{n,s}^2\}.\]
